task: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

ownership_changes.criterion: Independent, no PE or VC, profitable (€19.5M revenue, €1.19M net profit)
ownership_changes.why: It is controlled by the H2P holding, which was set up with backing from corporates GEODIS and STEF. That is a corporate-parent and corporate-investor structure, not founder or family ownership. No PE or VC is named, so confidence is medium.

merged.claim: Riege Software International GmbH (riege.com) fits the thesis: Meerbusch, Germany-based, family-owned (founded 1985) SaaS transport management system (Scope) for air/ocean freight and customs, with 120+ employees (LinkedIn band 51-200), 900+ customers in 60 countries, and no VC/PE funding found.
